notes.title: Patch 1 is out now.
notes.notes:
Hello Folks, we added a lot of missing features.


    Fix Subtitles and missing ingame help/notifications
    Fix delay when player "dies"
    Add switch for fullscreen/windowed mode
    Add switch for resolutions
    Add option to change ingame volume
    Minor code improvements
    Replaced model of Phasergun (yes there is a hidden gun)


Also the game has now translations for german and spanish language.

notes.title: 🕯 Community Update: We're Sorry for the delay. This Hurts. 🕯
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This is not the update we wanted to write. Not today.

We've been holding onto hope until the last possible minute, expecting to share a major milestone with you—something that was supposed to happen 18th of June.


This date wasn’t picked at random. It meant something deeply personal to us. It marked a promise, a rhythm in our creative journey, and a moment we wanted to share with all of you who believed in 3Tower from day one.

But Steam… well, they had other plans. Or rather, no plan—at least none that matched the urgency we poured into this.

We've been stuck in their approval limbo for weeks, waiting for a green light that just never came. Emails, tickets, polite nudges… we did everything short of flying to Valve HQ with a lantern and a haunting playlist. The delay isn’t on us. The game is ready. We are ready. But bureaucracy, slow gears, and radio silence swallowed a launch that was incredibly important to us and, honestly, to this community.

We’re frustrated. We’re heartbroken. We’re sorry.

We don’t like to rant, and we don’t like blaming external forces, but this time, we owe you honesty. This delay doesn’t just mess with timelines—it messes with trust. Yours, and ours.

So what now?

We keep going. 3Tower lives. The graveyard may be full of the restless dead, but we’re not joining them just yet. As soon as we get that Steam OK, we’ll let you know. And we’ll be back with something to make it up to you. That’s a promise.

Thank you for sticking with us. You deserve better. And we’ll make sure you get it.

— Swen, Jasmin, and the whole Wechselbalg Studio team 🖤

notes.title: 3Tower Release Announcement – August 18, 2025
notes.notes:
We’re proud to announce that 3Tower will be available on August 18th, 2025.

This haunting journey through the Graveyard of 3Tower marks more than just a game release for us. It’s a beginning born from both creativity and deep emotion.

The date is no coincidence. It’s been exactly ten years since we lost our daughter Hailey during childbirth. What was once the saddest day in our lives now becomes a moment to share something new—something meaningful. 3Tower is, in many ways, a tribute to life, memory, and the strange beauty that can emerge from grief.

We know 3Tower is just the beginning. There will be patches, and we're listening closely to your feedback. How the story of the 3Tower Graveyard continues will depend in part on your experiences and reviews.

Thank you for being part of this journey.
– Swen & Jasmin
Wechselbalg Studio
